 Sandesh D. Patil, Jj.

Date : 03rd February, 2026
 P.C. :
1.

The present application is filed for condonation of delay of 11 days caused in filing the Criminal
Appeal for leave to file Appeal against the Judgment and Order dated 18/02/2019 passed by the
learned Special Judge and Additional Sessions Judge, Thane in Special Case No.105 of 2014 for the
offences Manushree Nesarikar punishable u/s 376, 506 of the Indian Penal Code and u/s 4
and Nesarikar 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (Pocso).
 Nesarikar

2.
In the present Interim Application notices were issued to the Respondent.
Learned APP has filed affidavit of service stating that the Respondent is served.
The said affidavit is placed on record before this Court.
3. We have heard the learned APP appearing for the Applicant.
She states that the impugned Judgment and Order was passed on 18/02/2019.
Application for certified copy was made on 21/02/2019.
It was ready on 14/03/2016 and was delivered on 15/03/2019.
She states that after scrutiny of the papers by the concerned Additional Public Prosecutor, the same was sent to the Law and Judiciary Department, Mantralaya.

She states that after the scrutiny, the Law and Judiciary Department, Mantralaya, had sent back the papers to the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Mumbai, Appellate Side, Mumbai, on 13/05/2019.

entities.text: High Court, Mumbai, Appellate Side, Mumbai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The application which is filed today is thus barred by delay of 11 days.
She states that the delay which is caused was not intentional but for the reasons mentioned above.
3/4 10-APPP-1022-19.odt 4. We have considered the submissions of the learned APP.
We find that the delay which is caused in filing the present application for leave to file Appeal is sufficiently explained by the Applicant in paragraph Nos.2 and 3 of the application.
We are convinced that the delay is not intentional or deliberate but for the reasons mentioned above.
We therefore condone the delay of 11 days caused in filing the criminal application.
5. Before parting with the order, we must make a note that the impugned Judgment and Order was passed on 18/02/2019.
The application for condonation of delay was filed on 20/06/2019 by the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Appellate Side, Mumbai.
However, inspite of passage of about more than six years, the office of the learned Public Prosecutor has not taken any steps to circulate the matter.

It is also important to note that, even today, the application is listed before us not because the office of the Public Prosecutor has circulated the matter, but it is the office/registry that has listed the matter on their own.
We deprecate this practice of the office of the Public Prosecutor especially in serious matters where the 4/4 10-APPP-1022-19.odt offences under POCSO Act are involved.
We must indicate our strong disapproval to this practice.
We expect that the office of the learned Public Prosecutor acts on this inaction, in such matters where serious offences are made out, as early as possible and on their own.
6. We accordingly allow the application.
The delay of 11 days in filing the application is condoned.
7. The application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.

(SANDESH D. PATIL, J.) (SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
